?Court No. - 1
Case :- Misc. Bench No. - 30192 of 2019
Petitioner :- Mohd. Saeed @ Mo Saeed
Respondent :- State Of U.P.Thru.Prin.Secy.Food & Civil Supplies & Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Kumar Jaiswal,J.
Hon'ble Alok Mathur,J.
Heard Sri Sheikh Mohammad Ali, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Manish Mishra, learned
Standing Counsel for the respondents/State.

Petitioner has filed an application for grant of license, vide annexure no. 1, under the provisions of Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and the Regulations made thereunder but till date his application has not been decided by the Authority concerned and, therefore, a prayer has been made to decide the same expeditiously.

Sri Manish Mishra, learned Standing Counsel has submitted that if the application of the petitioner is still pending , then the same will be decided in light of the Order of this Court dated 12.5.2017 passed in Writ Petition No. 8293 (MB) of 2017.

Considering the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Competent Authority/respondent No.3 is directed to consider and decide the application of the petitioner for registration of license, as the case may be, in accordance with law, in the light of the order dated Mohd. 1 12.5.2017 passed by this Court in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017, within a period of two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before him by a reasoned and speaking order.
